¿Qué significa exactamente una brecha de: What exactly is a coverage gap?
Es la diferencia en puntos porcentuales: It is the percentage-point difference between the attention a story receives in your reference outlets versus your own newsroom within a time window. It raises an auditable editorial question; it never auto-decides what to publish.
